Roo Code Extension Launches 225-Agent Configuration Library for 2026 Standards

Roo Code has released a professional AI agent configuration library featuring 225 specialized agents for VS Code. This update provides enhanced AI coding assistance configurations aligned with modern software development principles.

🧩 How it works

The repository contains a meticulously curated collection of YAML-based configurations designed to accelerate development workflows. Each agent is optimized for 2026 development standards, utilizing a modular architecture that supports cross-platform compatibility. The system includes production-ready templates that allow for easy customization through YAML files.

⚙️ Key details

The library emphasizes security-first architecture and performance optimization. All agents are updated to reference the latest 2026 technology stack. Key technical specifications include:

  • Compliance with 2026 Security Standards, including OWASP and Zero-Trust.
  • 225 specialized agents organized across 10 categories.
  • 11 State-of-the-Art (SOTA) reasoning personas designed for advanced cognitive workflows.

💡 Why it matters

This collection supports comprehensive domain coverage for modern software development. By integrating industry best practices with specific reasoning personas, the library enables developers to deploy AI assistance that adheres to current security and performance benchmarks.
